description: Run one read-only ClickHouse SELECT over Ironflow's Hyperliquid tables (hl.fills, hl.wallet_daily, hl.wallet_behavior, hl.funding, hl.mark_prices, hl.oracle_prices, hl.open_interest, hl.liquidations, hl.builder_fills, hl.transfers, hl.vault_operations). Aggregate in SQL: results are capped (1,000 rows keyless). Keyless: last 24 hours, 5 s per query, 60 query seconds per hour per IP; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key gives 30 days of history.

max_rows.description: Most rows to return (default 200, capped by your tier)

sql.description: One ClickHouse SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) over hl.* tables, without a FORMAT clause

name: run_query

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

truncated.description: true when more rows existed than were returned

title: Run SQL query
